title: task.returned_for_rework v1
description: Return for rework from Finishing: Working under a fresh lease, or Ready when the previous builder is not free.

lease_seat_id.description: The builder seat given a fresh lease by this event, or null when it gives none. Replay sets the task's holder from it.

wait_cause.description: Why the wait_ready step this event opens is waiting: credential_limit when no seat is eligible only because no candidate is available and none is signed out, else null. Null when the event opens no wait_ready step. Fixed when the step opens (PRD, Rules for steps, rule 8).
